sentences.en: When I was little, I supposedly ate nothing but peaches.
sentences.zh: 当我还是个孩子的时候，据说我只吃桃子。

sentences.en: How much malice is hidden in your supposedly innocent eyes?
sentences.zh: 你那看似无辜的眼睛里藏着多少恶意？

sentences.en: Supposedly, one in ten Europeans are conceived in an IKEA bed.
sentences.zh: 据说每十个欧洲人中就有一个是在宜家的床上受孕的。

senses.zh: 据认为，据推测；据称；一般相信，一般看来
